Our program provides a comprehensive curriculum focused on investment readiness, scaling strategies, and market positioning. In addition, participants gain access to a powerful network of experienced tech founders, investors, and industry experts, ensuring they have the guidance, resources, and connections needed to secure funding and accelerate growth. ​ Our hands-on incubator program is designed to provide tailored support to startups with emerging technologies as they prepare to raise a Seed or Series A round. Our team of experienced mentors, investors, and industry leaders works closely with each founder to understand their unique business challenges and develop actionable solutions. The Emerging Tech Impact Cohort The Emerging Tech Impact Cohort is a 7-week, hybrid learning experience that equips Staten Island high school students with foundational AI literacy, problem-solving skills, and hands-on project experience. Students work in teams to identify real community challenges and design responsible, tech-informed solutions, culminating in a public Tech Showcase at CSI’s new Innovation Hub space. Program Start: May 12, 2026 Timeframe: 4:30pm to 6:30pm Weekly in-person session Location: 35B Bay Street Build a real project with a team Learn how AI actually works Create a pitch de ck like startups do Present at a Tech Showcase Walk away with a certificate of completion What you will do Week 1: Team formation Week 2: AI introduction Week 3: Coding basics Week 4: Design thinking Weeks 5–7: Pitch deck development Final event: Tech Showcase Students gain practical, future-ready skills while building confidence. Your partnership is the difference-maker in recruiting strong student teams. APPLY NOW become a college mentor CSI or CUNY
